messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I have an upcoming flight from Houston (IAH) to Seattle (SEA) on May 23. I’d like to move that flight to May 24 and also upgrade to business class for all passengers on that booking. Can you help with this?

content:
"text": "I can help with that. To proceed with moving your IAH-SEA flight from May 23 to May 24 and upgrading to business class for all passengers on this booking, I need a couple of details:

- Your airline user ID
- Your reservation ID (if you know it). If you don't know the reservation ID, I can locate it using your user ID.

Action details before I proceed:
- Route: IAH -> SEA
- Original date: 2024-05-23; New date: 2024-05-24
- Cabin upgrade: All passengers will be moved to business class for all flights in the reservation (the cabin must be the same across all flights).
- Passengers: Up to 5
- Availability and price: I will check business-class availability for May 24 and apply any fare difference. If the new fare is higher, you will pay the difference; if lower, you’ll receive a refund.
- Payment: A single payment method already on file will be used for any fare difference. If you have a preferred method on file, let me know; otherwise I’ll use your default.
- Basic Economy caveat: If any flight in this reservation is Basic Economy, this change may not be possible and would require a human agent.

Please reply with YES to proceed and include your user ID and reservation ID (or say LOCATE to have me locate it)."

messages.content: Yes, please proceed! My user ID is liam_khan_2521. I don't have my reservation ID handy—could you locate it for me?
